title: Roosters Harder Hardcore
description: A lightweight  modpack that makes minecraft VERY hard
body:
**A lightweight modpack that makes Minecraft VERY hard.**

**This modpack is also MADE for multiplayer, so feel free to invite your friends!**

1. Automatically sets game difficulty to hardcore. (There is a set time before you/your friend dies to revive them)

2. All mob AI is better/smarter 

3. Almost all aspects of the game are made harder

4. Many new challenges to beat (for example, the witherstorm, or a reworked end fight)

5. World gen and weather improved for realism and a challenge 

   And much, much more!
